slides.title: Speaking: long turn, debate and presentation
slides.subtitle: B2 speaking skills
goals: Speak for 2 minutes on a topic.

slides.title: Long turn strategy
list: Take 30 seconds to plan: 3 main points.
Start with a clear opening: *I'd like to talk about…*
Develop each point with a reason and an example.
Use fillers to gain time: *Well, let me think…*

slides.title: Your turn
body: Talk for 2 minutes: *"Describe a skill you would like to learn and explain why."* Record yourself.
